about: Checks on the bake itself. fitStart: chi2 at the fit's start values. rerun: d0.py runs bake() twice from scratch in one process and refuses to write unless every output is byte-identical; sha256 is d0-fit.json's digest from each pass. `d0.py --check`, run later as its own process, recomputes it and fails on any difference. The digest holds for this file, code and package versions (numpy, scipy, Python): notes/bake.md names the versions it was made with.

fitStart.about: chi2 of the 45-bin fit at the start values read off the histogram (d0-fit.json iterations[0]); curveReadout recomputes it as dk-curve's live readout does (sum of pulls squared, model at the bin centre x 2 MeV).
